values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

values.note: DEC lists 204 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 197, all back-in: 58 listed at 30 ft, 101 at 20 ft, 38 with no length. Large, well-forested sites on the southeast shore of Raquette Lake.

summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident and the 1-night reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), ReserveAmerica 9-month window and 14-night max (DEC row, now on the entry), opening May 14 2027 (matches). Added season close 09-05 (Labor Day), 204 sites to 30 ft (all back-in), no electric, showers, dump, water spigots. AWH note kept. Not stated: flush toilets (RA lists pit/vault toilets as an amenity).
flags: Season note (manual, 2026-10-20) says 'Reservable through Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend); DEC posts no later date.' DEC's 2026 summary does post a close: 'Golden Beach ... May 15 ... Sept 7' (Labor Day 2026). Suggest: 'Closes on Labor Day: Sep 7 in 2026 (DEC summary), Sep 5 in 2027 (ReserveAmerica).'
Missing phone: Golden Beach Campground 315-354-4230 (DEC 2026 campground summary).

Missing operator website: the entry has only the ReserveAmerica link; add DEC's campground page (dec.ny.gov/places/golden-beach-campground, following the pattern of the other DEC entries; dec.ny.gov answers 403 to scripted reads, so the path was not opened).

Weak waterfront lead: ReserveAmerica tags every campsite 'Near Water - no', while the entry is lakefront. Probably RA's default tag (it does this at every DEC campground checked); listed only because it is a booking-engine water claim contrary to ours.
Minor: most bookable sites are listed at 20 ft (101 of 197); a 23-ft rig should pick from the 58 listed at 30 ft or the 38 with no length.
